check-interval: Ticks between equipment checks (best armour and weapon).
bots-relog: Bring bots back after a server restart.
force-vulnerable: Clear the invulnerable flag on bots. Login plugins set it and never clear it.
auth-autologin: Register bots with the login plugin (AuthMe and similar) so it stops freezing them.
bypass-damage-protection: Un-cancel damage involving bots. Overrides region and PvP protection, so use with care.
target-scan-interval: Ticks between target searches. Raise it if a large crowd of bots lags.
target-players: Pick players as targets unprompted (off = mobs only, unless ordered or hit).
target-passive-mobs: Also pick passive and neutral mobs as targets (off = hostile mobs only).
revenge: Fight back against whoever hits the bot.
bot-vs-bot: Bots pick fights with each other unprompted.
attack-invincible: Also attack players in creative or spectator mode.
max-target-distance: How far (in blocks) a bot looks for targets.
melee-range: Reach, from the eyes to the hitbox as vanilla measures it (3.0 = a player's).
melee-standoff: Distance held in melee, so bots don't stand inside each other.
ping-millis: Simulated latency: delays when a decided attack lands, like a real client's round trip (0 = instant, unrealistically perfect).
miss-chance: Percent of swings and shots missed on purpose.
mistake-chance: Chance to hesitate or panic on a clutch action (0 = flawless).
leader-call-seconds: How many seconds a faction stays hostile to whoever its leader is fighting (0 = off).
reaction-ticks: Ticks a bot sizes up a player it noticed on its own before attacking (0 = at once).
spawn-grace: Seconds after spawning before a bot starts a fight with a player on its own.
skill: How human a bot's reactions, timing and aim are. Never frame-perfect, even at 100.
turn-speed: Most degrees a bot turns per tick (180 = instant snap-aim, the old behaviour).
special-weapon-melee-chance: Percent of fights where a mace carrier uses an ordinary weapon instead.
shield-disable-chance: Percent of raised shields a bot reacts to by switching to an axe.
mace-range-bonus: Extra reach on a mace smash, on top of melee-range (a deliberate advantage).
attribute-swap: Master switch for the weapon-swap techniques (breach swap, mace stun, lunge).
breach-swap: Hit with a sword carrying the mace's Breach/Density enchantments.
mace-stun: Axe to break a raised shield, then the mace straight after without waiting for the cooldown.
spear-lunge: Chain spear jabs to close distance (needs Lunge to actually dash).
swap-cooldown: Ticks between swap combos. This is the real limit, since combos skip the normal attack cooldown.
mace-pearl-launch: Throw a pearl, then pop a wind charge on it mid-flight for a much higher launch.
mace-defence-shield: Percent of incoming mace smashes answered with a shield.
mace-defence-flee: Percent answered by getting out of the way (the rest are taken).
mace-totem-chance: Percent of mace fights where the bot keeps a totem in the offhand instead of a shield.
elytra-mace: Elytra mace: climb on rockets, dive and smash without landing (needs elytra, rockets and a mace).
elytra-mace-height: Blocks above the target to climb before diving. Higher hits harder.
cart-pvp: Cart PvP: a Flame arrow, then a rail and a TNT minecart in its path (needs all three, plus arrows).
cart-max-self-damage: Most damage (after armour, on an average roll) a bot accepts from its own cart. Never a lethal roll without a totem.
crit-chain: Chain jump crits back to back instead of resting between hops.
cooldown-trick: Swing at 84.8% attack cooldown instead of 100%: full crit and knockback, just faster.
jump-reset: Chain another mace smash right after landing one, instead of waiting for the cooldown.
mirror-punish: Swing back mid-air off the enemy's own knockback the instant they hit (a punish crit).
hit-select: Hold a swing until the angle and spacing are favourable, instead of swinging on cooldown alone.
d-tap: A brief sideways sprint reset after landing a hit: the w-tap idea on a lateral axis.
hit-web-combo: Follow a landed cobweb trap with an immediate swing instead of leaving the web to work alone.
sweep-hit: Drop sprint to land vanilla's sweep attack when 2 or more enemies are close in melee.
priority-hp-target: Within the same priority, prefer the lowest-health target over the nearest.
shield-read-windup: Raise the shield early when reading a jump-crit windup, not only against a mace smash.
orbital: Fire Orbital Strike Cannon rods, staying clear of their own blast.
crits: Jump before swinging to land critical hits.
stasis: Block a killing hit and teleport away (ender pearl effect) instead of dying. Off makes a protected faction killable again.
shield-disable: Switch to an axe to break a blocking enemy's shield.
break-stashes: Break a shulker box or ender chest the target placed nearby, denying a mid-fight restock.
follow-distance: How far a follower stays from whoever it escorts.
auto-equip: Wear the best armour and hold the best weapon carried.
auto-repair: Collect nearby XP orbs and mend damaged gear with them.
auto-repair-bottles: Once nearby orbs run out, crack carried XP bottles to mend gear.
auto-totem: Grab a totem when close to death.
totem-health: Health at which the totem goes into the hand.
retreat: Back off when low on health.
food-threshold: Food level below which to eat.
shield-health: Health at which to start blocking.
auto-potion: Drink healing potions and eat golden apples.
buff-potions: Drink strength, speed and fire resistance before a fight.
pearls: Use ender pearls to escape and to chase runners.
pearl-escape-health: Health at which to pearl away.
pearl-chase-distance: How far a fleeing target must be before the bot pearls after them.
cobweb-range: How close before webbing (lower = must commit).
cobweb-cooldown: Ticks between webs from one bot.
cobweb-global-cooldown: Ticks between webs from ANY bot, so a squad can't chain-web you (0 = off).
drain: Scoop up water an enemy places (MLG denial).
drain-delay: Reaction delay in ticks before draining.
web-escape-delay: Ticks a webbed bot takes to react and reach for its water bucket (each web adds up to 50% more).
web-escape-fumble-chance: Percent of water escapes a webbed bot botches, losing a beat before trying again.
totem-delay-ticks: Pause before a panic totem reaches the offhand (instant would look inhuman).
water-clutch: MLG a water bucket to survive a long fall.
water-clutch-min-fall: Shortest fall worth a bucket (below this the bot takes the damage).
water-clutch-window: Blocks above the ground where the water goes down (widens with falling speed).
water-clutch-pickup: Scoop the water back up after landing.
ranged-min-range: Closer than this, switch to melee.
bow-min-draw-ticks: Draw time before releasing (20 = full draw).
arrow-prediction: Lead shots ahead of moving targets.
ranged-shot-gap: Fewest ticks between one arrow and the next draw.
ranged-volley-size: Most arrows in a row before lowering the bow (each volley is 1 to this many).
ranged-rest-ticks: How long the bot stops shooting after a volley, closing in meanwhile.
building: Let bots bridge, pillar and dig through soft cover (never stone or anything built).
building-bridge: Place a block to cross a gap.
building-pillar: Tower up toward a target that is above and out of reach.
building-clear-soft: Dig through dirt, sand, gravel, leaves and undergrowth in the way.
building-budget: Most blocks a bot may place and break per minute.
building-max-pillar: Tallest tower a bot will build.
detection: Bots must actually see a target to know about it (off = the old plain-radius sweep).
detection-touch-radius: Within this distance a target is noticed even without line of sight.
detection-memory-ticks: How long a spotted target stays known after leaving line of sight.
detection-invisible: Notice-range multiplier against an invisible player (0.15 = spotted at 15% of the usual distance).
detection-armoured: Multiplier against a player wearing armour.
detection-unarmoured: Multiplier against a player wearing none.
